criterion_text: With injected mount/unmount failure or an Agent restart during prepare/cleanup, recovery consults durable mount identity/generation plus actual mountinfo and live execution records; it never reports an unverified mount Ready, releases a Lower cache pin prematurely, deletes a live or uncertain upper, adopts a foreign mount, or silently falls back to Native.

verifiers.summary: Injected mount/unmount failures and a crash during prepare recover only from verified durable identity and mountinfo, never delete live or uncertain bytes, and never fall back

evidence.value: exact SHA 0676864406c0aa52b9d5ccf535088a1b7f11c7e9 on Linux kernel 7.0.0-1017-azure: an injected fuse-overlayfs mount failure left a Failed state with the lower released and no mount; a helper that mounted nothing was never Ready; an injected unmount failure retained the live mount, the lower pin and the durable upper and a bounded retry released them; a crashed owner process leaving a live mount was re-adopted only from the verified durable identity and a mount that disappeared was reported unavailable rather than served
